name: LinkedIn API
tagline: Professional network API for profiles, org pages, posts, and ads
description: LinkedIn provides REST APIs for developers to access professional network data: member profiles, company/organization pages, content sharing, messaging, and advertising. Most products require OAuth 2.0 and LinkedIn Developer application approval; consumer-facing open endpoints are limited. Marketing, Community Management, and Talent/Learning products have separate product access and rate limits.

auth.details: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow (3-legged) for member data; client credentials for some app-only products. Create an app at LinkedIn Developers, request product access (e.g. Sign In with LinkedIn, Marketing Developer Platform), use access tokens as Bearer tokens.

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown — product access and usage quotas are per LinkedIn product; no simple public free-tier request quota published for the core REST API
pricing.paid_plans: LinkedIn Marketing Solutions / Advertising APIs and some enterprise products are paid; many developer products are free with application approval and daily application limits

rate_limits: not published as a single global limit; application and member daily limits apply per product (e.g. throttle headers; see product-specific docs)
use_cases: sign users in with LinkedIn OpenID Connect and fetch basic profile
get authenticated member profile fields via Share on LinkedIn / Sign In products
publish posts or share content to a LinkedIn organization page
manage LinkedIn Ads campaigns and creative via Marketing Developer Platform
retrieve organization page statistics and follower counts
